title: 叠山 peakscape
description:
描绘我幻想的中式园林。
Depict the Chinese garden I imagine.
body:
![picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac09090cf22ab45e94d4394b4322a3dd29b33b3e.jpeg)
这个数据包/模组旨在展示我对中式园林的奇思妙想及在我的世界建筑中的体悟，我也乐意将这些灵感制作并分享给大家，祝大家游玩愉快！
目前已增加结构列表：
维园、随便观（源自游戏绝区零，彩蛋结构）

This datapack/mod is designed to showcase my creative ideas about Chinese gardens and my insights into building in Minecraft. I’m happy to turn these inspirations into a mod and share them with everyone. I hope you all enjoy playing!
(machine translation, please forgive me.)
The following structures have been added:
Wei Garden, Random Play (From the game "zenless zone zero",Easter egg structure)
